# Smart glasses

Every app in this list that runs on Smart glasses. That is 3 apps with 1 for Plex and 2 for Jellyfin and 0 for Emby. Apps for more than one server count once per server. The legend is in [README.md](../README.md#legend) and every other platform is in [PLATFORMS.md](../PLATFORMS.md).

> **Want these apps to play straight from debrid or Usenet?** [rex](https://rex.debridmediamanager.com/) and [zurg](https://zurg.debridmediamanager.com/) are made by the team that keeps this list. [See what they do.](../README.md#from-the-maintainers)

## Video and general

- [GladEyes](https://github.com/audiojoe4444/GladEyes) - Plex client for Meta Ray-Ban Display glasses. `Plex` · `Smart glasses` · `MIT`
- [Tachi](https://github.com/buggzd/tachi) - Spatial media client for RayNeo Air glasses. `Jellyfin` · `Smart glasses` · `MIT` `Free`

## Music

- [manet-glasses-player](https://github.com/Gio53/manet-glasses-player) - Music player for Meta Ray-Ban Display glasses. `Jellyfin` · `Smart glasses` · `Open source`
